articles.title: President Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
articles.snippet: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well," said Ukrainian President Zelensky.

articles.title: New York permanently bars Celsius founder Mashinsky in $35M fraud settlement
articles.snippet: The agreement resolves a 2023 civil fraud lawsuit against the Celsius founder and permanently bars him from the cryptocurrency, securities and commodities industries.

articles.title: New York AG Secures Up to $35M and Industry Ban From Ex-Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky
articles.snippet: Mashinsky owes New York $25 million if he fails to forfeit another $10 million, and $10 million more if he doesn't serve his full sentence.
